name: Nomor Referensi Transaksi
desc: Digunakan untuk mengidentifikasi pesan MT940 secara unik.
desc_en: Used to uniquely identify the MT940 message.
rules: Hanya karakter alphanumeric dan beberapa karakter khusus (SWIFT character set). Panjang maksimal 16 karakter.
rules_en: Alphanumeric and limited special characters (SWIFT character set). Max 16 characters.

name: Identifikasi Rekening
desc_en: IBAN or BBAN account number.
rules: Panjang maksimal 35 karakter. Dapat diawali dengan Kode BIC dan tanda garis miring (/) jika diterima melalui Business Online.
rules_en: Max 35 characters. Can be preceded by BIC and a slash (/) if received via Business Online.

name: Nomor Laporan / Nomor Urut
desc: Nomor laporan rekening diikuti nomor urut pesan.
desc_en: Statement number followed by sequence number; resets to 1 every January 1st.
rules: Format: N/N (nomor laporan / nomor urut pesan). Nomor laporan bertambah secara berurutan dan direset ke 1 setiap tanggal 1 Januari.
rules_en: Format: N/N (statement number / sequence number). Statement number resets to 1 every January 1st.

name: Saldo Awal
desc_en: First opening balance in the statement.
rules: Format: [Indikator C/D][Tanggal YYMMDD][Mata Uang 3 karakter][Jumlah]. Tanpa spasi.
rules_en: Format: [C/D][YYMMDD][ISO Currency][Amount]. No spaces between components.

name: Indikator Kredit/Debit
desc: C untuk Kredit, D untuk Debit.
desc_en: C for credit, D for debit.
rules: Nilai valid: C (Kredit), D (Debit).
rules_en: Valid values: C (Credit), D (Debit).

name: Tanggal Saldo Awal
desc_en: Opening balance date (YYMMDD).
rules: Format tanggal: YYMMDD. Tanggal dari entri pembukuan terakhir.
rules_en: Date format: YYMMDD. Date of the last booking entry.

name: Mata Uang
desc_en: ISO 4217 currency code.
rules: Kode mata uang ISO 3 karakter uppercase. Contoh: USD, DKK, EUR.
rules_en: ISO 3-character uppercase currency code. Examples: USD, DKK, EUR.

name: Jumlah
desc_en: Nominal value of the opening balance.
rules: Pemisah desimal berupa koma (,). Tanpa pemisah ribuan. Maksimal 15 karakter.
rules_en: Decimal separator is comma (,). No thousands separator. Max 15 characters.

name: Saldo Awal Sementara
desc: Saldo awal sementara (interim) untuk pesan laporan berikutnya dalam hari yang sama.
desc_en: Intermediate opening balance for subsequent statement messages on the same day.
rules: Format sama dengan 60F. Digunakan jika laporan terbagi dalam beberapa pesan.
rules_en: Same format as 60F. Used when the statement is split across multiple messages.

name: Indikator Kredit/Debit
desc: C untuk Kredit, D untuk Debit.
desc_en: C for credit, D for debit.
rules: Nilai valid: C (Kredit), D (Debit).
rules_en: Valid values: C (Credit), D (Debit).

name: Tanggal Saldo Awal
desc_en: Opening balance date (YYMMDD).
rules: Format tanggal: YYMMDD.
rules_en: Date format: YYMMDD.

name: Mata Uang
desc_en: ISO 4217 currency code.
rules: Kode mata uang ISO 3 karakter uppercase.
rules_en: ISO 3-character uppercase currency code.

name: Jumlah
desc_en: Nominal value of the opening balance.
rules: Pemisah desimal berupa koma (,). Tanpa pemisah ribuan. Maksimal 15 karakter.
rules_en: Decimal separator is comma (,). No thousands separator. Max 15 characters.

name: Baris Transaksi
desc_en: Contains transaction details for the account.
rules: Terdiri dari beberapa sub-field tanpa spasi: Tanggal Valuta, Tanggal Entri (opsional), Tanda Kredit/Debit, Kode Dana (opsional), Nominal, Tipe Transaksi, Referensi Nasabah, Referensi Bank (opsional), dan Detail Tambahan (opsional).
rules_en: Consists of multiple contiguous subfields: Value Date, Entry Date (optional), C/D Mark, Funds Code (optional), Amount, Transaction Type, Customer Ref, Bank Ref (optional), and Supplementary Details (optional).

name: Tanggal Valuta
desc_en: Effective date when funds are credited/debited (YYMMDD).
rules: Format tanggal: YYMMDD.
rules_en: Date format: YYMMDD.

name: Tanggal Entri
desc_en: Bank booking entry date (MMDD).
rules: Format: MMDD. Opsional. Jika kosong, tanggal entri sama dengan tanggal valuta.
rules_en: Format: MMDD. Optional. If absent, entry date equals value date.

name: Indikator Kredit/Debit
desc_en: Direction of the transaction.
rules: C untuk Kredit, D untuk Debit, RC untuk Reversal of Credit (Debit), RD untuk Reversal of Debit (Kredit).
rules_en: C for Credit, D for Debit, RC for Reversal of Credit (Debit entry), RD for Reversal of Debit (Credit entry).

name: Kode Dana
desc_en: Third character of the currency code (optional).
rules: Hanya diisi jika bank menggunakan kode dana khusus.
rules_en: Only populated if bank uses special fund codes.

name: Jumlah
desc_en: Nominal value of the transaction entry.
rules: Pemisah desimal berupa koma (,). Maksimal 15 karakter.
rules_en: Decimal separator is comma (,). Max 15 characters.

name: Jenis Transaksi
desc_en: Identification code of the transaction type.
rules: Format: S3!n untuk SWIFT (mis. S103, S202), N3!c untuk transfer Non-SWIFT (mis. NTRF, NMSC), F3!c untuk transaksi bank internal (mis. FINT, FCHG).
rules_en: Format: S3!n for SWIFT instructions (e.g. S103, S202), N3!c for Non-SWIFT (e.g. NTRF, NMSC), F3!c for bank-originated (e.g. FINT, FCHG).

name: Referensi Pemilik Rekening
desc: Referensi transaksi yang ditentukan oleh nasabah (Customer Reference).
desc_en: Transaction reference assigned by the account owner (Customer Reference).
rules: Maksimal 16 karakter. Jika melebihi, sisa karakter dialihkan ke subfield berikutnya.
rules_en: Maximum 16 characters. Extra characters are carried over to the next subfield.

name: Referensi Bank
desc: Referensi transaksi yang ditentukan oleh bank pembayar.
desc_en: Transaction reference assigned by the servicing bank.
rules: Diawali dengan tanda '//' diikuti maksimal 16 karakter.
rules_en: Prefixed with '//' followed by maximum 16 characters.

name: Detail Tambahan
desc_en: Supplementary information concerning the transaction.
rules: Maksimal 34 karakter. Sering digunakan untuk kode mata uang dan nominal asal (original amount) sebelum konversi.
rules_en: Max 34 characters. Often used for original amount / currency before conversion.

name: Informasi untuk Pemilik Rekening
desc: Informasi tambahan terstruktur atau bebas mengenai transaksi.
desc_en: Additional structured or free-text details about the transaction.
rules: Maksimal 6 baris @ 65 karakter. Pada Danske Bank, diisi dengan pasangan tag terstruktur /KEY/VAL.
rules_en: Maximum 6 lines of 65 characters. Danske Bank uses structured /KEY/VAL labels.

name: Referensi End-to-End
desc_en: Creditor's End-to-End reference from the original payment.
rules: Jika tidak ada, bernilai 'Not Provided'.
rules_en: If not present, the value defaults to 'Not Provided'.

name: ID Instruksi / ID Transaksi
desc: ID instruksi atau ID transaksi pembayaran.
desc_en: Instruction ID or Transaction ID of the payment.

name: Kode Skema Pembayaran
desc_en: Identification code of the payment scheme.

name: Tanggal Jatuh Tempo Asal
desc: Tanggal jatuh tempo asli koleksi pembayaran.
desc_en: Original due date of the collection.

name: Referensi Bank Penerima
desc: Referensi Danske Bank atas transfer dari luar negeri.
desc_en: Danske Bank reference of the transfer from abroad.

name: Filing Code (Finlandia)
desc: Filing Code khusus untuk rekening di Finlandia.
desc_en: Filing Code (restricted to accounts in Finland only).

name: Nama Kreditur
desc: Nama organisasi atau pihak kreditur (penerima dana).
desc_en: Name of the creditor organization or party.

name: Nama Debitur
desc: Nama organisasi atau pihak debitur (pembayar dana).
desc_en: Name of the debtor organization or party.

name: Rekening Kreditur
desc_en: Bank account number of the creditor.

name: Rekening Debitur
desc_en: Bank account number of the debtor.

name: BIC Kreditur
desc_en: Bank Identifier Code (BIC) of the creditor's bank.

name: BIC Debitur
desc_en: Bank Identifier Code (BIC) of the debtor's bank.

name: Informasi Remitansi
desc: Berisi berita transfer atau info pembayaran.
desc_en: The remittance/payment information from the original payment.
rules: Maksimal 65 karakter per baris.
rules_en: Maximum of 65 characters per line.

name: Debitur Akhir (Ultimate Debtor)
desc_en: Name of the actual ultimate debtor of the payment.
rules: Hanya diisi jika terdapat ultimate debtor yang terpisah dari pengirim (ordering party).
rules_en: Only present if ultimate debtor differs from ordering party.

name: Kreditur Akhir (Ultimate Creditor)
desc_en: Name of the actual ultimate beneficiary/creditor.

name: Alasan Pengembalian (Return Reason)
desc: Kode alasan pengembalian jika transaksi ditolak/diretur.
desc_en: Return reason code if the payment is rejected/returned.

name: Biaya Transaksi (Charges)
desc: Biaya total Danske Bank terkait transaksi ini.
desc_en: Danske Bank total charges related to this specific transaction.
rules: Diawali kode mata uang sebelum nominal.
rules_en: Preceded by currency code before the amount.

name: Nilai Kurs (Exchange Rate)
desc: Nilai tukar mata uang yang digunakan.
desc_en: Exchange rate used in the transaction.
rules: Format: [Dari Mata Uang]-[Ke Mata Uang] [Nilai Kurs]. Contoh: DKK-EUR 7.451286
rules_en: Format: [From Currency]-[To Currency] [Rate Value]. E.g. DKK-EUR 7.451286

name: Saldo Akhir
desc: Saldo buku akhir final pada rekening.
desc_en: Final closing booked balance of the statement.
rules: Format: [Indikator C/D][Tanggal YYMMDD][Mata Uang][Jumlah]. Tanpa spasi.
rules_en: Format: [C/D][YYMMDD][ISO Currency][Amount]. No spaces between components.

name: Indikator Kredit/Debit
desc: C untuk Kredit, D untuk Debit.
desc_en: C for credit, D for debit.
rules: C atau D.
rules_en: C or D.

name: Tanggal Saldo Akhir
desc_en: Effective date of the closing balance (YYMMDD).

name: Mata Uang
desc_en: ISO 4217 currency code.

name: Jumlah
desc_en: Nominal value of the closing balance.
rules: Pemisah desimal koma.
rules_en: Decimal separator is comma.

name: Saldo Akhir Sementara
desc: Saldo akhir sementara (interim) untuk pesan laporan antara.
desc_en: Intermediate closing booked balance of the statement.
rules: Format sama dengan 62F.
rules_en: Same format as 62F.

name: Indikator Kredit/Debit
desc: C untuk Kredit, D untuk Debit.
desc_en: C for credit, D for debit.

name: Tanggal Saldo Akhir
desc_en: Effective date of the closing balance (YYMMDD).

name: Mata Uang
desc_en: ISO 4217 currency code.

name: Jumlah
desc_en: Nominal value of the closing balance.

name: Saldo Tersedia Akhir
desc: Saldo yang tersedia (value date balance) pada akhir periode laporan.
desc_en: Closing available balance (value date balance) at the end of the period.
rules: Format sama dengan 62F. Bersifat wajib (mandatory) pada Danske Bank.
rules_en: Same format as 62F. Mandatory in Danske Bank MT940 implementations.

name: Indikator Kredit/Debit
desc: C untuk Kredit, D untuk Debit.
desc_en: C for credit, D for debit.

name: Tanggal Saldo Tersedia
desc_en: Effective date of available balance (YYMMDD).

name: Mata Uang
desc_en: ISO 4217 currency code.

name: Jumlah
desc_en: Nominal value of available balance.

name: Nomor Referensi Transaksi
desc: Digunakan untuk mengidentifikasi pesan MT942 secara unik.
desc_en: Used to uniquely identify the MT942 message.
rules: Karakter alphanumeric. Panjang maksimal 16.
rules_en: Alphanumeric characters. Max 16 characters.

name: Referensi Terkait
desc_en: Related reference number.
rules: Selalu kosong / tidak digunakan.
rules_en: Always empty / not used.

name: Identifikasi Rekening
desc_en: IBAN or BBAN account number.
rules: Panjang maksimal 35 karakter.
rules_en: Max 35 characters.

name: Nomor Laporan / Nomor Urut
desc: Nomor laporan rekening diikuti nomor urut pesan.
desc_en: Statement number followed by sequence number; resets to 1 every January 1st.

name: Indikator Batas Minimum (Floor Limit) — Debit
desc: Batas minimum transaksi debit agar disertakan dalam pesan laporan.
desc_en: Floor limit for debit entries to be included in the message.
rules: Format: [Mata Uang][D][Jumlah]. Contoh: DKKD0,00 (artinya semua transaksi debit disertakan).
rules_en: Format: [Currency][D][Amount]. E.g. DKKD0,00 (meaning all debit transactions are included).

name: Mata Uang
desc_en: Currency of the floor limit.

name: Indikator Kredit/Debit
desc_en: Indication of floor limit direction (D for debit).

name: Jumlah Batas Minimum
desc_en: Nominal floor limit amount for debit transactions.

name: Indikator Batas Minimum (Floor Limit) — Kredit
desc: Batas minimum transaksi kredit agar disertakan dalam pesan laporan.
desc_en: Floor limit for credit entries to be included in the message.
rules: Format: [Mata Uang][C][Jumlah]. Contoh: DKKC0,00 (artinya semua transaksi kredit disertakan).
rules_en: Format: [Currency][C][Amount]. E.g. DKKC0,00 (meaning all credit transactions are included).

name: Indikasi Tanggal/Waktu
desc: Tanggal, waktu, dan zona waktu saat laporan dibuat oleh bank.
desc_en: Date, time, and timezone offset when the message was generated.
rules: Format: [YYMMDD][HHMM][+/-][Offset HHMM]. Contoh: 2303151230-0400 (15 Maret 2023 jam 12:30 dengan offset UTC -04:00).
rules_en: Format: [YYMMDD][HHMM][+/-][Offset HHMM]. E.g. 2303151230-0400 (March 15, 2023 at 12:30, timezone offset UTC -04:00).

name: Tanggal Laporan
desc_en: Date of generation (YYMMDD).

name: Waktu Laporan
desc_en: Time of generation (HHMM).

name: Arah Offset Zona Waktu
desc: Tanda arah offset zona waktu (+ atau -).
desc_en: Direction indicator of the timezone offset (+ or -).

name: Nilai Offset Zona Waktu
desc_en: Timezone offset value from UTC (HHMM).

desc_en: Contains transaction details for the account.
rules: Format sama dengan 61 pada MT940.

desc_en: Effective date of credit/debit (YYMMDD).

desc_en: Additional structured or free-text details about the transaction.

desc_en: Total number and value of debit entries reported in this message.

rules_en: Format: [Count 5n][Currency 3a][Total Amount 15d]. E.g. 3USD2080000000,00

name: Jumlah Entri Debit
desc_en: Quantity of debit transactions.

name: Mata Uang
desc_en: Currency of debit entries.

name: Total Nominal Debit

name: Jumlah dan Total Entri Kredit
name_en: Number and Sum of Credit Entries
desc: Jumlah kuantitas dan total nilai nominal entri transaksi kredit.
desc_en: Total number and value of credit entries reported in this message.
rules: Format: [Kuantitas 5 digit][Mata Uang 3 karakter][Total Nominal]. Contoh: 1USD900000100,00
rules_en: Format: [Count 5n][Currency 3a][Total Amount 15d]. E.g. 1USD900000100,00

name: Jumlah Entri Kredit
desc_en: Quantity of credit transactions.

name: Mata Uang
desc_en: Currency of credit entries.

name: Total Nominal Kredit

name: Mulai Blok — Informasi Umum
desc: Menandai awal blok Sequence A (Informasi Umum).
desc_en: Marks the start of Sequence A block (General Information).
rules: Nilai wajib: GENL
rules_en: Required value: GENL

name: Nomor Halaman / Indikator
desc: Nomor halaman dan indikator apakah ini satu-satunya halaman.
desc_en: Page number and indicator whether this is the only page.
rules: Format: [Nomor halaman]/[ONLY|LAST|MORE]. Contoh: 1/ONLY
rules_en: Format: [Page number]/[ONLY|LAST|MORE]. Example: 1/ONLY

name: Referensi
desc: Berisi berbagai referensi pesan. Muncul berulang dengan qualifier berbeda.
desc_en: Contains various message references. Repeats with different qualifiers.
rules: Qualifier umum: SEME (Sender's Reference), CORP (Corporate Action Ref), COAF (Official Event Ref), CAIN (Corporate Action Instruction Ref). Format: :QUALIFIER//VALUE
rules_en: Common qualifiers: SEME (Sender's Reference), CORP (Corporate Action Ref), COAF (Official Event Ref). Format: :QUALIFIER//VALUE

name: Referensi Pesan Pengirim
desc: Referensi unik yang ditetapkan pengirim untuk pesan ini.
desc_en: Unique reference assigned by the sender for this message.
rules: Maksimal 16 karakter. Wajib ada di setiap pesan MT564.
rules_en: Maximum 16 characters. Mandatory in every MT564 message.

name: Referensi Corporate Action
desc: Referensi event corporate action yang ditetapkan oleh agen.
desc_en: Corporate action event reference assigned by the agent.
rules: Maksimal 16 karakter.
rules_en: Maximum 16 characters.

name: Referensi Resmi Event
desc: Referensi resmi event corporate action dari otoritas berwenang.
desc_en: Official corporate action event reference from an authorised body.
rules: Opsional. Maksimal 16 karakter.
rules_en: Optional. Maximum 16 characters.

name: Fungsi Pesan
desc_en: Specifies the function/purpose of the message.
rules: Nilai umum: NEWM (Notifikasi baru), REPL (Penggantian), CANC (Pembatalan), COPY (Salinan), ADVI (Advis). Subfunction opsional setelah '/'.
rules_en: Common values: NEWM (New notification), REPL (Replacement), CANC (Cancellation), COPY (Copy), ADVI (Advice). Optional subfunction after '/'.

name: Indikator
desc: Field indikator yang digunakan untuk berbagai tujuan dengan qualifier. Muncul berulang.
desc_en: Indicator field used for various purposes with qualifiers. Repeats.
rules: Qualifier utama: CAEV (Tipe Event: DVCA=Cash Dividend, BONU=Bonus Issue, RHTS=Rights Issue, dsb), CAMV (Mandatory/Voluntary), DIVI (Dividend Type). Format: :QUALIFIER//KODE
rules_en: Main qualifiers: CAEV (Event Type: DVCA=Cash Dividend, BONU=Bonus Issue, RHTS=Rights Issue, etc), CAMV (Mandatory/Voluntary), DIVI (Dividend Type). Format: :QUALIFIER//CODE

name: Tipe Event Corporate Action
desc_en: Corporate action event type code.
rules: Kode umum: DVCA (Cash Dividend), DVSE (Stock Dividend), BONU (Bonus Issue), RHTS (Rights Issue), SPLF (Stock Split), MRGR (Merger), TEND (Tender Offer), EXRI (Rights Exercise), CONV (Conversion), MEET (Meeting).
rules_en: Common codes: DVCA (Cash Dividend), DVSE (Stock Dividend), BONU (Bonus Issue), RHTS (Rights Issue), SPLF (Stock Split), MRGR (Merger), TEND (Tender Offer), EXRI (Rights Exercise), CONV (Conversion), MEET (Meeting).

name: Indikator Mandatory/Voluntary
desc: Menunjukkan apakah corporate action bersifat wajib atau sukarela.
desc_en: Indicates whether the corporate action is mandatory or voluntary.
rules: MAND = Mandatory (wajib), VOLU = Voluntary (sukarela), CHOS = Mandatory with choice.
rules_en: MAND = Mandatory, VOLU = Voluntary, CHOS = Mandatory with choice.

name: Tanggal/Waktu
desc: Tanggal dan waktu dengan qualifier. Muncul berulang untuk tanggal berbeda.
desc_en: Date and time with qualifier. Repeats for different dates.
rules: Format: :QUALIFIER//YYYYMMDDHHMMSS. Qualifier umum: PREP (Preparation Date/Time).
rules_en: Format: :QUALIFIER//YYYYMMDDHHMMSS. Common qualifier: PREP (Preparation Date/Time).

name: Kode Status
desc_en: Processing status of the corporate action.
rules: Qualifier: PROC. Nilai: COMP (Completed), PEND (Pending), CANC (Cancelled), RJCT (Rejected).
rules_en: Qualifier: PROC. Values: COMP (Completed), PEND (Pending), CANC (Cancelled), RJCT (Rejected).

name: Flag
desc_en: Boolean flag indicator (Y/N).
rules: Format: :QUALIFIER//Y atau N. Qualifier: ACTI (Active Flag).
rules_en: Format: :QUALIFIER//Y or N. Qualifier: ACTI (Active Flag).

name: Akhir Blok — Informasi Umum
desc: Menandai akhir blok Sequence A (Informasi Umum).
desc_en: Marks the end of Sequence A block (General Information).
rules: Nilai wajib: GENL
rules_en: Required value: GENL

name: Mulai Blok — Underlying Securities
desc: Menandai awal blok Sequence B (Underlying Securities).
desc_en: Marks the start of Sequence B (Underlying Securities).
rules: Nilai wajib: USECU
rules_en: Required value: USECU

name: Identifikasi Instrumen Keuangan
sample:
ISIN US0231351067
Apple Inc Common Stock
desc: Identifikasi sekuritas yang menjadi underlying corporate action. Berisi ISIN dan deskripsi.
desc_en: Identifies the underlying security for the corporate action. Contains ISIN and description.
rules: Baris 1: ISIN diikuti kode ISIN 12 karakter (opsional). Baris 2-5: Deskripsi bebas (max 4x35 karakter). Salah satu harus ada.
rules_en: Line 1: ISIN followed by 12-char ISIN code (optional). Lines 2-5: Free text description (max 4x35 chars). At least one must be present.

name: Kode ISIN
desc_en: International Securities Identification Number (12 characters).
rules: Format: 2 huruf kode negara + 9 karakter alfanumerik + 1 check digit. Contoh: US0231351067
rules_en: Format: 2-letter country code + 9 alphanumeric chars + 1 check digit. Example: US0231351067

name: Tempat/Lokasi
desc_en: Specifies a place or location with qualifier.
rules: Qualifier: SAFE (Place of Safekeeping), TRAD (Place of Trade). Format: :QUALIFIER//KODE[/Informasi tambahan]
rules_en: Qualifier: SAFE (Place of Safekeeping), TRAD (Place of Trade). Format: :QUALIFIER//CODE[/Additional info]

name: Pihak (BIC)
desc_en: Identifies a party using BIC.
rules: Qualifier: ACOW (Account Owner), ACCT (Account). Format: :QUALIFIER//BIC
rules_en: Qualifier: ACOW (Account Owner), ACCT (Account). Format: :QUALIFIER//BIC

name: Rekening
desc_en: Account number with qualifier.
rules: Qualifier: SAFE (Safekeeping Account). Format: :QUALIFIER//NOMOR_REKENING
rules_en: Qualifier: SAFE (Safekeeping Account). Format: :QUALIFIER//ACCOUNT_NUMBER

name: Akhir Blok — Underlying Securities
desc_en: Marks the end of Sequence B block.
rules: Nilai wajib: USECU
rules_en: Required value: USECU

name: Mulai Blok — Detail Corporate Action
name_en: Start of Block — Corporate Action Details
desc: Menandai awal Sequence C (Detail Corporate Action).
desc_en: Marks the start of Sequence C (Corporate Action Details).
rules: Nilai wajib: CADETL
rules_en: Required value: CADETL

name: Tanggal
desc_en: Date with qualifier. Repeats.
rules: Format: :QUALIFIER//YYYYMMDD. Qualifier umum: RDTE (Record Date), XDTE (Ex-Date/Ex-Dividend Date), PAYD (Payment Date), ANOU (Announcement Date), EFFD (Effective Date), MEET (Meeting Date), DEAD (Deadline).
rules_en: Format: :QUALIFIER//YYYYMMDD. Common qualifiers: RDTE (Record Date), XDTE (Ex-Date), PAYD (Payment Date), ANOU (Announcement Date), EFFD (Effective Date), MEET (Meeting Date), DEAD (Deadline).

name: Record Date
desc: Tanggal di mana kepemilikan saham menentukan eligibilitas untuk menerima corporate action.
desc_en: Date on which security ownership determines eligibility to receive the corporate action.
rules: Format: YYYYMMDD.
rules_en: Format: YYYYMMDD.

name: Ex-Dividend Date
desc: Tanggal pertama di mana saham diperdagangkan tanpa hak dividen/corporate action.
desc_en: First date on which the security trades without the right to receive the corporate action.
rules: Format: YYYYMMDD. Umumnya 2 hari kerja sebelum Record Date.
rules_en: Format: YYYYMMDD. Usually 2 business days before Record Date.

name: Payment Date
desc: Tanggal pembayaran dividen atau distribusi corporate action.
desc_en: Date on which the dividend or corporate action distribution is paid.
rules: Format: YYYYMMDD.
rules_en: Format: YYYYMMDD.

name: Nilai / Rate
desc: Rate atau nilai dengan qualifier. Muncul berulang.
desc_en: Rate or value with qualifier. Repeats.
rules: Format: :QUALIFIER//[N]15d (N opsional untuk nilai negatif). Qualifier umum: GRSS (Gross Dividend Rate), NETT (Net Rate), TAXR (Tax Rate), WITL (Withholding Tax Rate), PRFC (Price Factor).
rules_en: Format: :QUALIFIER//[N]15d (N optional for negative value). Common qualifiers: GRSS (Gross Dividend Rate), NETT (Net Rate), TAXR (Tax Rate), WITL (Withholding Tax Rate).

name: Gross Dividend Rate
desc: Nilai dividen bruto per saham sebelum pajak.
desc_en: Gross dividend value per share before tax deductions.
rules: Desimal dengan koma. Contoh: 0,05 berarti USD 0.05 per saham.
rules_en: Decimal with comma. Example: 0,05 means USD 0.05 per share.

name: Withholding Tax Rate
desc: Persentase withholding tax yang dipotong dari pembayaran.
desc_en: Withholding tax percentage deducted from the payment.
rules: Nilai dalam desimal, bukan persentase. 0,15 = 15%.
rules_en: Value in decimal, not percentage. 0,15 = 15%.

name: Jumlah Sekuritas
desc: Kuantitas sekuritas dengan qualifier dan tipe kuantitas.
desc_en: Quantity of securities with qualifier and quantity type.
rules: Format: :QUALIFIER//TIPEKUANTITAS/JUMLAH. Qualifier: QINS (Quantity Instructed), ELIG (Eligible Quantity), OWND (Quantity Owned). Tipe: UNIT (unit), FAMT (Face Amount), AMOR (Amortised Value).
rules_en: Format: :QUANTITYTYPE/AMOUNT. Qualifiers: QINS (Quantity Instructed), ELIG (Eligible), OWND (Owned). Types: UNIT, FAMT (Face Amount), AMOR.

name: Nomor Opsi
desc: Nomor opsi dalam corporate action dengan qualifier.
desc_en: Corporate action option number with qualifier.
rules: Qualifier: CAON (Corporate Action Option Number). Format: :QUALIFIER//3 digit angka. Contoh: :CAON//001
rules_en: Qualifier: CAON (Corporate Action Option Number). Format: :QUALIFIER//3 digit number. Example: :CAON//001

name: Jumlah Uang
desc: Nilai uang dengan qualifier dan mata uang.
desc_en: Monetary amount with qualifier and currency.
rules: Format: :QUALIFIER//[N]CurrencyAmount. Qualifier umum: ENTL (Entitlement Amount), GRSS (Gross Amount), NETT (Net Amount), TXFR (Transfer Fee), CINL (Cash In Lieu).
rules_en: Format: :QUALIFIER//[N]CurrencyAmount. Common qualifiers: ENTL (Entitlement), GRSS (Gross Amount), NETT (Net Amount), TXFR (Transfer Fee).

name: Narasi
desc: Field narasi bebas untuk informasi tambahan.
desc_en: Free-format narrative field for additional information.
rules: Format: :QUALIFIER//Max 10 baris x 35 karakter. Qualifier umum: ADTX (Additional Text), PACO (Contact Details).
rules_en: Format: :QUALIFIER//Max 10 lines x 35 chars. Common qualifiers: ADTX (Additional Text), PACO (Contact Details).

name: Akhir Blok — Detail Corporate Action
name_en: End of Block — Corporate Action Details
desc_en: Marks the end of Sequence C block.
rules: Nilai wajib: CADETL
rules_en: Required value: CADETL

name: Mulai Blok — Opsi Corporate Action
name_en: Start of Block — Corporate Action Option
desc: Menandai awal blok Opsi Corporate Action. Opsional dan dapat berulang.
desc_en: Marks the start of the Corporate Action Options block. Optional and repeatable.
rules: Nilai: CAOPTN. Satu blok per opsi yang tersedia.
rules_en: Value: CAOPTN. One block per available option.

name: Tipe Opsi Corporate Action
desc: Tipe opsi yang tersedia bagi pemegang saham.
desc_en: Type of option available to the security holder.
rules: Nilai umum: CASH (Pembayaran tunai), SECU (Pembayaran sekuritas), OVER (Oversubscription), NOAC (No Action), PRUN (Pro-rata).
rules_en: Common values: CASH (Cash payment), SECU (Security payment), OVER (Oversubscription), NOAC (No Action), PRUN (Pro-rata).

name: Flag Default Opsi
desc: Menandai apakah opsi ini adalah opsi default.
desc_en: Indicates whether this option is the default option.
rules: Y = Opsi default, N = Bukan default.
rules_en: Y = Default option, N = Not default.

name: Akhir Blok — Opsi Corporate Action
name_en: End of Block — Corporate Action Option
desc: Menandai akhir blok Opsi Corporate Action.
desc_en: Marks the end of the Corporate Action Options block.
rules: Nilai: CAOPTN
rules_en: Value: CAOPTN

name: Mulai Blok — Informasi Tambahan
desc: Menandai awal Sequence F (Informasi Tambahan). Opsional.
desc_en: Marks the start of Sequence F (Additional Information). Optional.
rules: Nilai: ADDINFO
rules_en: Value: ADDINFO

name: Teks Tambahan
desc_en: Free-form narrative for additional information.
rules: Maksimal 10 baris, masing-masing 35 karakter.
rules_en: Maximum 10 lines, each 35 characters.

name: Akhir Blok — Informasi Tambahan
desc_en: Marks the end of Sequence F block.
rules: Nilai: ADDINFO
rules_en: Value: ADDINFO

name: Transfer Dana Lembaga Keuangan (Cover)
desc: Format transaksi antarbank koresponden untuk mendanai instruksi pembayaran nasabah (MT103) yang dikirim secara terpisah.
desc_en: Correspondent bank transfer used to cover/fund a client payment instruction (MT103) routed via a separate channel.

name: Konfirmasi Kredit (Confirmation of Credit)
desc: Format transaksi konfirmasi kredit yang dikirimkan oleh bank koresponden kepada pemilik rekening (bank penerima) sebagai pemberitahuan bahwa rekeningnya telah dikredit sejumlah dana.
desc_en: Standard SWIFT message sent by a correspondent bank to the account owner (receiving bank) to confirm that its account has been credited with a specified amount.

name: Referensi Transaksi
desc_en: Uniquely identifies this MT910 confirmation message.
rules: Karakter alfanumerik. Panjang maksimal 16 karakter.
rules_en: Alphanumeric characters. Max length 16 characters.

name: Referensi Terkait
desc: Merujuk ke referensi transaksi asal yang mendasarinya (seperti referensi pesan cover MT202 atau transfer MT103).
desc_en: Refers to the underlying transaction reference (e.g. cover payment reference or transfer reference).
rules: Karakter alfanumerik. Panjang maksimal 16 karakter.
rules_en: Alphanumeric characters. Max length 16 characters.

name: Identifikasi Rekening
desc: Mengidentifikasi rekening pemilik yang dikredit dana di bank pengirim pesan.
desc_en: Identifies the account of the owner being credited at the sending bank.
rules: Panjang maksimal 35 karakter.
rules_en: Max length 35 characters.

name: Tanggal Valuta, Kode Mata Uang, dan Jumlah
name_en: Value Date, Currency Code, and Amount
desc: Menentukan tanggal valuta, kode mata uang, dan nominal dana yang dikreditkan.
desc_en: Specifies the value date, currency code, and credited amount.
rules: Format: [YYMMDD][Mata Uang][Jumlah]. Pemisah desimal koma (,). Tanpa spasi.
rules_en: Format: [YYMMDD][Currency][Amount]. Decimal separator is comma (,). No spaces.

name: Tanggal Valuta
desc_en: Effective date of the credit entry (YYMMDD).
rules: Format tanggal: YYMMDD.
rules_en: Date format: YYMMDD.

name: Kode Mata Uang
desc_en: ISO 4217 currency code.
rules: Kode mata uang ISO 3 karakter uppercase.
rules_en: ISO 3-character uppercase currency code.

name: Jumlah Kredit
desc_en: Nominal value of the credited funds.
rules: Pemisah desimal berupa koma (,). Tanpa pemisah ribuan. Maksimal 15 karakter.
rules_en: Decimal separator is comma (,). No thousands separator. Max 15 characters.

name: Nasabah Pengirim (Ordering Customer) - Pilihan A
desc: Nasabah yang menginstruksikan transaksi (diidentifikasi dengan BIC).
desc_en: Customer who ordered the transaction (identified by BIC).
rules: Format: Nomor rekening opsional diawali slash (/), diikuti oleh BIC 8 atau 11 karakter.
rules_en: Format: Optional account number prefixed by slash (/), followed by 8 or 11 character BIC.

name: Nasabah Pengirim (Ordering Customer) - Pilihan F
desc: Nasabah yang menginstruksikan transaksi (dengan format terstruktur nama & alamat).
desc_en: Customer who ordered the transaction (with structured name & address format).
rules: Menggunakan format baris terstruktur SWIFT dengan kode angka penanda.
rules_en: Uses structured SWIFT line format with code indicators.

name: Nasabah Pengirim (Ordering Customer) - Pilihan K
desc: Nasabah yang menginstruksikan transaksi (nama & alamat bebas).
desc_en: Customer who ordered the transaction (unstructured name & address).
rules: Baris pertama berisi nomor rekening dengan slash (/), baris berikutnya nama dan alamat (maksimal 4 baris).
rules_en: First line contains account number prefixed by slash (/), subsequent lines for name and address (max 4 lines).

name: Lembaga Pengirim (Ordering Institution) - Pilihan A
desc: Lembaga keuangan yang menginstruksikan transaksi (diidentifikasi dengan BIC).
desc_en: Financial institution that ordered the transaction (identified by BIC).
rules: Format: Nomor rekening opsional diawali slash (/), diikuti oleh BIC 8 atau 11 karakter.
rules_en: Format: Optional account number prefixed by slash (/), followed by 8 or 11 character BIC.

name: Lembaga Pengirim (Ordering Institution) - Pilihan D
desc: Lembaga keuangan yang menginstruksikan transaksi (nama & alamat bebas).
desc_en: Financial institution that ordered the transaction (unstructured name & address).
rules: Baris pertama berisi nomor rekening opsional, baris berikutnya nama dan alamat.
rules_en: First line contains optional account number, subsequent lines for name and address.

name: Lembaga Perantara (Intermediary Institution) - Pilihan A
desc: Lembaga keuangan perantara tempat dana disalurkan sebelum ke penerima.
desc_en: Financial institution intermediary through which the funds are routed.
rules: Format: Nomor rekening opsional diawali slash (/), diikuti oleh BIC 8 atau 11 karakter.
rules_en: Format: Optional account number prefixed by slash (/), followed by 8 or 11 character BIC.

name: Lembaga Perantara (Intermediary Institution) - Pilihan D
desc_en: Financial institution intermediary (unstructured name & address).
rules: Baris pertama berisi nomor rekening opsional, baris berikutnya nama dan alamat.
rules_en: First line contains optional account number, subsequent lines for name and address.

name: Informasi Pengirim ke Penerima
desc: Keterangan atau instruksi khusus dari bank pengirim ke bank penerima.
desc_en: Specific instructions or information from the sending bank to the receiving bank.
rules: Maksimal 6 baris masing-masing 35 karakter. Gunakan format terstruktur jika diperlukan.
rules_en: Max 6 lines of 35 characters each. Use structured format prefixes if required.
